title: Tetschen Nordwestbf. (– Prag) – Wien Nordwestbf. und zurück (Auszugsweise)
notes: Winter 1913/14, pp. 182-183 (extract; tables 127 and 128 printed under it are not laid out). As in the summer layout, p182 is two panels: p1 the upper section (rows 0-30, label column to x 392, c1-c15) and p2 the lower section from "in Prag Ö.N.W.B." (rows 31-43), where the label column narrows and a further train column c0 appears (c0-c15); p3 is p183 (rows 50-93, c16-c30; its label column ends at the rule at x 289, with a train column before the next rule at 352). Kept rows are the summer ones and keep their numbers: r1 Dresden Hbf. 23, r2 a. Tetschen N.W.B., r29 in Prag F.J.B., r31 in Prag Ö.N.W.B., r43 i. Wien N.W.Bf.; r50 aus Wien N.W.Bf., r62 a. Prag Ö.N.W.B., r64 a. Prag F.J.B., r91 i. Tetsch. N.W.B., r92 in Dresd. Hbf. 23 - so the summer altRows [[29,31,43],[50,62,64]] and dittoMarkers {"1": "a."} still point at the same stations. The table prints no train numbers: the header band of p1/p2 is the strip with the table's top rule (as in summer); p3's is its classes line. Each section has its own notes box. Deskew by hand: p1 0.45, p2 0.27 (its lines of times slope differently), p3 0.45 deg. Hard spot: below r91 on p183 the connection rows "in Dresd. Hbf. 23" (r92, kept) and "Leipz. Hbf." are printed in narrower sub-columns: five values under c16-c19 (c18's train has two Dresden connections, "!9 39" printed mostly over c17 and "10 48"); from c20 on they line up with the grid. The summer page has the same arrangement (its G2 census note on 126 c22 r92).
